content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Today, you can immediately set up a fully functional digital commerce stack using free tools and blockchain payments. Start by creating a GitHub Pages site or a Cloudflare Pages site to host your store. Integrate NOWPayments for seamless crypto transactions, allowing international buyers to purchase without the barriers imposed by traditional payment systems. You can have your products listed and ready for sale by the end of the day, empowering you to reach customers worldwide without delay.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

To establish a minimum viable stack, utilize GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your digital products. Pair this with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing. This setup allows you to accept various cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds at a fee of less than $0.10, ensuring quick and cost-effective transactions. This stack is robust enough to handle your needs while being entirely sovereign.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Avoid getting bogged down by unnecessary complexities at this stage. Focus on your core offerings and the infrastructure that enables transactions. Don’t worry about advanced marketing strategies or sophisticated analytics until your store is operational. Concentrate on deploying your products, integrating NOWPayments for payment processing, and ensuring your files are delivered promptly. Other aspects can be optimized later once your commerce stack is live and generating revenue.
Blockchain payments eliminate the geographic barriers that traditional platforms create.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To facilitate your first transaction, ensure your products are uploaded and your NOWPayments integration is functional. Share your store link across social media platforms, targeting potential customers, especially those familiar with cryptocurrencies. Use Binance P2P to convert local currencies like Pakistani Rupees directly into cryptocurrencies if needed. Once a transaction is completed, you can immediately witness the power of blockchain payments as your customer receives their digital product seamlessly.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, focus on refining your offerings and promoting your store. Engage with customers on social media, and consider creating content around your digital products to attract more attention. Monitor your sales and gather initial feedback to improve the user experience. Additionally, you may want to explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for comprehensive resources that can elevate your store's capabilities, providing you with all six blueprints and seven templates needed for scaling.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
You can get your digital store live today with free infrastructure tools.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and other restricted markets searching for international payment solutions are looking for the same thing: a way to receive USD-equivalent payments from global buyers without a Stripe or PayPal account. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete answer — Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments deployed under your accounts in 48 hours. For creators who want to self-deploy, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 covers both stack options with full source code and step-by-step configuration guides. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Confirm which cryptocurrencies have the best P2P conversion options in your specific country before configuring your payment settings — USDT on Tron is a safe starting point for most African and South Asian markets. Create your NOWPayments account and add wallet addresses for your primary coins. Set up a P2P exchange account — Binance P2P is available in most restricted markets and supports local currency pairs. Deploy your chosen stack: Stack 01 via the Sovereign Blueprint or Stack 02 via the Edge Commerce Stack deployment. Configure the NOWPayments IPN webhook URL in your account settings pointing to your backend endpoint. Run a complete mainnet test transaction and confirm the pipeline end-to-end before promoting. Complete a test P2P conversion with a small amount so you know the process before your first real sale.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell digital products in Pakistan without a Stripe account?

You can sell digital products in Pakistan by using blockchain payment solutions like NOWPayments, which allows you to accept various cryptocurrencies without needing a conventional payment processor like Stripe.
What payment methods work for online sales in Nigeria?

In Nigeria, you can use local crypto exchanges and services like Binance P2P to convert Naira into cryptocurrencies, which can then be accepted through platforms like NOWPayments for your digital products.
How do I integrate NOWPayments into my store?

Integrating NOWPayments involves creating an account on their platform, then following their documentation to connect it with your store. This typically includes adding API keys and setting up webhooks for payment notifications.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my digital downloads?
NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins like USDT on Tron, making it flexible for international customers.
Can I use Cloudflare Workers for my e-commerce backend?
Yes, Cloudflare Workers can serve as your e-commerce backend, enabling you to handle requests and manage your digital product transactions efficiently without relying on external servers.
